title: Netflix — Cyberpunk: Edgerunners title and episode list
evidence_section: Original season episodes 8–10 and separate audio tracks
summary: Netflix lists episode 8 as Stay, with Rebecca and Lucy confronting David about his behavior; episode 10 is My Moon My Man. English and original Japanese audio are distinct tracks. The listing alone does not establish the death mechanism.

demographics.canonical_endpoint_episode: Season 1, episode 10 — My Moon My Man
